summary: Cul-de-sac head backing onto bush, but homes within 20-27 m and no parking convention.
reasons: Houses 19-27 m away round the bulb
Quiet residential street, no parked cars

best_section.where: Bush-side kerb at the head of the Thea Court turning circle

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush to the north and west; nearest dwellings are 19 m and 26-27 m away on the other sides of the bulb.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed cul-de-sac head with width to pull in; only 10 m of kerb, enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end residential street; local traffic only.
drivers.convention: No cars parked in Esri or QLD; a van would stand out to residents.

flags: Steep per DEM about 5%, but only 0.5 m rise over 10 m
Low-lying: Witton Creek 105 m away, elevation about 54 m so not flood-prone
sun_shade: Bush canopy to the north and west shades the section; open to the east and south sun.
cannot_judge: Whether residents object to overnight vans
